name: Piggy
description: An 8-bit team pet: a shared piggy that walks in the corner of Mattermost and needs to be fed, petted and played with, or it dies.

settings_schema.header: One piggy shared by the whole server. Its needs only drop during working hours, Monday to Friday.

settings.help_text: Every new piggy after a death gets this name plus its generation (Bacon II, Bacon III...).
Trigger of the slash command, without the slash.
Working days without anybody feeding or playing with the piggy until it dies (1 to 30). It gets hungry after a third of that and sick a bit later.
Hour (0-23) when the piggy wakes up and its needs start to drop.
Hour (1-24) when the piggy goes to bed. Outside working hours and on weekends nothing drops.
IANA time zone of the working hours, e.g. Europe/Madrid.
team-name/channel-name where the piggy says it is sick or has died. Empty: no announcements.
